shape.text: Airtable states a prefix, alphabet or length for the former user API key.

unresolved.reason: The pinned notice and changelog and the current pages state dates and access scope but no format; the one rule artifact on record does not meet the corroboration requirement.

issuance.text: Airtable describes the former user API key as giving all-or-nothing access over everything the user's account could see or do, and lists August 1st, 2023 as the date after which new keys could no longer be created.

lifecycle.text: Airtable began the deprecation period for user API keys on 2023-01-18 and states existing keys can no longer be used to access its API after February 1st, 2024.

collisions.text: Airtable's current authentication reference names a legacy api_key URL parameter and says personal access tokens and OAuth access tokens cannot be passed through it.

openQuestions.text: The former key was presented to the API in one fixed way (a URL parameter, a bearer header or both).

unresolved.reason: No dated, pinned capture of the pre-2023 API reference was read; the current page names only the api_key parameter.
